title: Then
html_source: Do you know ‘what ends’ said Dixon Junior to Punch Costello.

anchor.prefix: against the Holy Ghost, Very God, Lord and Giver of Life? For, sirs, he said, our lust is brief. We are means to those small creatures within us and nature has other ends than we.
